current.text: He is back with Detroit and projected to start at center next to Cunningham, Robinson, Thompson and Collins.
Isaiah Stewart is gone, so Paul Reed is the main backup center and there is less frontcourt depth behind Duren.
Yahoo lists him as questionable (Rest). Josh says he is not injured.
He did not train hard during his contract holdout, so his conditioning is a concern.
He may be out of shape early in the season, with his minutes stuck around 27 to 28.
Detroit lost creation with Tobias Harris gone, so his usage could rise toward about 25%. If his minutes go above 28 and his usage rises, he could return third round value.
He has shown he can create his own shot on more plays, and he was efficient doing it.

Experts call him a fair third to fourth round player and say he is fine around pick 40. ESPN's rank of 23 is too high, he has no chance of returning value in the 20s, and Yahoo's rank in the low 30s is a little high.
In a mock auction he was valued at about 20 USD and went for 19 USD.
Detroit's playoff schedule is 4-3-4 games for a league ending March 28. The team has 15 back-to-backs, and no rest risks are expected.
Detroit is projected to win 50 to 51 games and finish as a third or fourth seed in the East.

durable.text: He is great in the pick and roll, on the offensive glass and on putbacks. He does not space the floor.
He is an unusual center. He is not a good defender and does not block many shots, so blocks are not a strength for him.
He is a strong FG% anchor because he shoots a very high percentage on real volume.
Rebounds are a clear strength, far above the player pool.
His free throw shooting is solid for a center and does not hurt like most bigs.

note: He is a FG% and rebounds anchor who makes no threes. He fits punt 3PM builds best, and his FT% does not hurt the way most centers' FT% does. Experts put him around pick 40 and a mock auction gave him 19 USD. That is close to Yahoo's average cost of 21.3 USD and well below ESPN's value of 34 USD, so stop bidding around 20 to 24 USD (he went for 14 USD in our league last season). In the first weeks, check whether his minutes climb above 28 as his conditioning improves, and whether his usage grows now that Tobias Harris is gone.
